versos.hebraico: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת שָׁל֔וֹשׁ לְמַלְכ֖וּת בֵּלְאשַׁצַּ֣ר הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ חָז֞וֹן נִרְאָ֤ה אֵלַי֙ אֲנִ֣י דָנִיֵּ֔אל אַחֲרֵ֛י הַנִּרְאָ֥ה אֵלַ֖י בַּתְּחִלָּֽה׃

controles.web: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared to me, even to me, Daniel, after that which appeared to me at the first.
controles.kjv: In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me, even unto me Daniel, after that which appeared unto me at the first.
controles.livre: No terceiro ano do reinado do rei Belsazar, apareceu uma visão a mim, Daniel, depois daquela que tinha me aparecido no princípio.

versos.hebraico: וָֽאֶרְאֶה֮ בֶּחָזוֹן֒ וַיְהִי֙ בִּרְאֹתִ֔י וַאֲנִי֙ בְּשׁוּשַׁ֣ן הַבִּירָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵילָ֣ם הַמְּדִינָ֑ה וָאֶרְאֶה֙ בֶּֽחָז֔וֹן וַאֲנִ֥י הָיִ֖יתִי עַל־אוּבַ֥ל אוּלָֽי׃

controles.web: I saw in the vision; now it was so, that when I saw, I was in the citadel of Susa, which is in the province of Elam; and I saw in the vision, and I was by the river Ulai.
controles.kjv: And I saw in a vision; and it came to pass, when I saw, that I was at Shushan in the palace, which is in the province of Elam; and I saw in a vision, and I was by the river of Ulai.
controles.livre: E vi em uma visão, (e aconteceu quando vi, que eu estava na fortaleza de Susã, que é na província de Elão) vi pois em uma visão, enquanto eu estava junto ao rio Ulai.

versos.hebraico: וָאֶשָּׂ֤א עֵינַי֙ וָאֶרְאֶ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֣ה׀ אַ֣יִל אֶחָ֗ד עֹמֵ֛ד לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֻבָ֖ל וְל֣וֹ קְרָנָ֑יִם וְהַקְּרָנַ֣יִם גְּבֹה֗וֹת וְהָאַחַת֙ גְּבֹהָ֣ה מִן־הַשֵּׁנִ֔ית וְהַ֨גְּבֹהָ֔ה עֹלָ֖ה בָּאַחֲרֹנָֽה׃

controles.web: Then I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, there stood before the river a ram which had two horns: and the two horns were high; but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.
controles.kjv: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, there stood before the river a ram which had two horns: and the two horns were high; but one was higher than the other, and the higher came up last.
controles.livre: E levantei meus olhos, e vi, e eis um carneiro que estava diante do rio, o qual tinha dois chifres; e os dois chifres eram altos, porém um era mais alto que o outro; e o mais alto subiu por último.

versos.hebraico: רָאִ֣יתִי אֶת־הָאַ֡יִל מְנַגֵּחַ֩ יָ֨מָּה וְצָפ֜וֹנָה וָנֶ֗גְבָּה וְכָל־חַיּוֹת֙ לֹֽא־יַֽעַמְד֣וּ לְפָנָ֔יו וְאֵ֥ין מַצִּ֖יל מִיָּד֑וֹ וְעָשָׂ֥ה כִרְצֹנ֖וֹ וְהִגְדִּֽיל׃

controles.web: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; and no animals could stand before him, neither was there any who could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and magnified himself.
controles.kjv: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; so that no beasts might stand before him, neither was there any that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and became great.
controles.livre: Vi que o carneiro estava ferindo com os chifres ao ocidente, ao norte, e ao sul, e nenhum dos animais podia o deter, nem havia quem se livrasse de seu poder;  e fazia conforme sua vontade, e se engrandecia.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲנִ֣י׀ הָיִ֣יתִי מֵבִ֗ין וְהִנֵּ֤ה צְפִיר־הָֽעִזִּים֙ בָּ֤א מִן־הַֽמַּעֲרָב֙ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י כָל־הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאֵ֥ין נוֹגֵ֖עַ בָּאָ֑רֶץ וְהַ֨צָּפִ֔יר קֶ֥רֶן חָז֖וּת בֵּ֥ין עֵינָֽיו׃

controles.web: As I was considering, behold, a male goat came from the west over the surface of the whole earth, and didn’t touch the ground: and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes.
controles.kjv: And as I was considering, behold, an he goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth, and touched not the ground: and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes.
controles.livre: E enquanto eu estava considerando, eis que um bode vinha do ocidente sobre a face de toda a terra, e ele não tocava a terra; e aquele bode tinha um chifre muito visível entre seus olhos;

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹ֗א עַד־הָאַ֨יִל֙ בַּ֣עַל הַקְּרָנַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאִ֔יתִי עֹמֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֣י הָאֻבָ֑ל וַיָּ֥רָץ אֵלָ֖יו בַּחֲמַ֥ת כֹּחֽוֹ׃

controles.web: He came to the ram that had the two horns, which I saw standing before the river, and ran on him in the fury of his power.
controles.kjv: And he came to the ram that had two horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran unto him in the fury of his power.
controles.livre: E ele veio até o carneiro que tinha os dois chifres, o qual eu tinha eu visto que estava diante do rio, e correu contra ele com o ímpeto de sua força.

versos.hebraico: וּרְאִיתִ֞יו מַגִּ֣יעַ׀ אֵ֣צֶל הָאַ֗יִל וַיִּתְמַרְמַ֤ר אֵלָיו֙ וַיַּ֣ךְ אֶת־הָאַ֔יִל וַיְשַׁבֵּר֙ אֶת־שְׁתֵּ֣י קְרָנָ֔יו וְלֹא־הָ֥יָה כֹ֛חַ בָּאַ֖יִל לַעֲמֹ֣ד לְפָנָ֑יו וַיַּשְׁלִיכֵ֤הוּ אַ֨רְצָה֙ וַֽיִּרְמְסֵ֔הוּ וְלֹא־הָיָ֥ה מַצִּ֛יל לָאַ֖יִל מִיָּדֽוֹ׃

controles.web: I saw him come close to the ram, and he was moved with anger against him, and struck the ram, and broke his two horns; and there was no power in the ram to stand before him; but he cast him down to the ground, and trampled on him; and there was no one who could deliver the ram out of his hand.
controles.kjv: And I saw him come close unto the ram, and he was moved with choler against him, and smote the ram, and brake his two horns: and there was no power in the ram to stand before him, but he cast him down to the ground, and stamped upon him: and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand.
controles.livre: E o vi chegar junto ao carneiro, e irritou-se contra ele, feriu o carneiro, e quebrou seus dois chifres, pois não havia no carneiro força para detê-lo; então derrubou-o na terra, e o pisou; não houve quem livrasse ao carneiro de seu poder.

versos.hebraico: וּצְפִ֥יר הָעִזִּ֖ים הִגְדִּ֣יל עַד־מְאֹ֑ד וּכְעָצְמ֗וֹ נִשְׁבְּרָה֙ הַקֶּ֣רֶן הַגְּדוֹלָ֔ה וַֽתַּעֲלֶ֜נָה חָז֤וּת אַרְבַּע֙ תַּחְתֶּ֔יהָ לְאַרְבַּ֖ע רוּח֥וֹת הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

controles.web: The male goat magnified himself exceedingly: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and instead of it there came up four notable horns toward the four winds of the sky.
controles.kjv: Therefore the he goat waxed very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven.
controles.livre: E o bode se engrandeceu muito; porém, quando estava em sua maior força, aquele grande chifre foi quebrado, e em seu lugar subiram outros quatro muito visíveis, na direção dos quatro ventos do céu.

versos.hebraico: וּמִן־הָאַחַ֣ת מֵהֶ֔ם יָצָ֥א קֶֽרֶן־אַחַ֖ת מִצְּעִירָ֑ה וַתִּגְדַּל־יֶ֛תֶר אֶל־הַנֶּ֥גֶב וְאֶל־הַמִּזְרָ֖ח וְאֶל־הַצֶּֽבִי׃

controles.web: Out of one of them came out a little horn, which grew exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the glorious land.
controles.kjv: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which waxed exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant land.
controles.livre: E de um deles saiu um chifre pequeno, o qual cresceu muito ao sul, ao oriente, e à terra formosa.

versos.hebraico: וַתִּגְדַּ֖ל עַד־צְבָ֣א הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַתַּפֵּ֥ל אַ֛רְצָה מִן־הַצָּבָ֥א וּמִן־הַכּוֹכָבִ֖ים וַֽתִּרְמְסֵֽם׃

controles.web: It grew great, even to the army of the sky; and some of the army and of the stars it cast down to the ground, and trampled on them.
controles.kjv: And it waxed great, even to the host of heaven; and it cast down some of the host and of the stars to the ground, and stamped upon them.
controles.livre: E engrandeceu-se até o exército do céu; e lançou por terra a alguns do exército e das estrelas, e as pisou.

versos.hebraico: וְעַ֥ד שַֽׂר־הַצָּבָ֖א הִגְדִּ֑יל וּמִמֶּ֨נּוּ֙ הרים הַתָּמִ֔יד וְהֻשְׁלַ֖ךְ מְכ֥וֹן מִקְדָּשֽׁוֹ׃

controles.web: Yes, it magnified itself, even to the prince of the army; and it took away from him the continual burnt offering, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.
controles.kjv: Yea, he magnified himself even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily sacrifice was taken away, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down.
controles.livre: Engrandeceu-se até contra o príncipe do exército, e por ele foi tirado o contínuo sacrifício , e o lugar de seu santuário foi derrubado.

versos.hebraico: וְצָבָ֛א תִּנָּתֵ֥ן עַל־הַתָּמִ֖יד בְּפָ֑שַׁע וְתַשְׁלֵ֤ךְ אֱמֶת֙ אַ֔רְצָה וְעָשְׂתָ֖ה וְהִצְלִֽיחָה׃

controles.web: The army was given over to it together with the continual burnt offering through disobedience; and it cast down truth to the ground, and it did its pleasure and prospered.
controles.kjv: And an host was given him against the daily sacrifice by reason of transgression, and it cast down the truth to the ground; and it practised, and prospered.
controles.livre: E por causa da transgressão, o exército lhe foi entregue, assim como o contínuo sacrifício ; e lançou a verdade em terra, e teve sucesso naquilo que fez.

versos.hebraico: וָאֶשְׁמְעָ֥ה אֶֽחָד־קָד֖וֹשׁ מְדַבֵּ֑ר וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אֶחָ֨ד קָד֜וֹשׁ לַפַּֽלְמוֹנִ֣י הַֽמְדַבֵּ֗ר עַד־מָתַ֞י הֶחָז֤וֹן הַתָּמִיד֙ וְהַפֶּ֣שַׁע שֹׁמֵ֔ם תֵּ֛ת וְקֹ֥דֶשׁ וְצָבָ֖א מִרְמָֽס׃

controles.web: Then I heard a holy one speaking; and another holy one said to that certain one who spoke, How long shall be the vision about the continual burnt offering, and the disobedience that makes desolate, to give both the sanctuary and the army to be trodden under foot?
controles.kjv: Then I heard one saint speaking, and another saint said unto that certain saint which spake, How long shall be the vision concerning the daily sacrifice, and the transgression of desolation, to give both the sanctuary and the host to be trodden under foot?
controles.livre: Depois ouvi um santo que falava; e outro santo disse ao que falava: Até quando durará a visão do contínuo sacrifício , e da transgressão assoladora, de modo que o santuário e o exército são entregues para serem pisoteados?

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֔י עַ֚ד עֶ֣רֶב בֹּ֔קֶר אַלְפַּ֖יִם וּשְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת וְנִצְדַּ֖ק קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

controles.web: He said to me, To two thousand and three hundred evenings and mornings; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.
controles.kjv: And he said unto me, Unto two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed.
controles.livre: E ele me disse: Até duas mil e trezentas tardes e manhãs; e o santuário será purificado.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֗י בִּרְאֹתִ֛י אֲנִ֥י דָנִיֵּ֖אל אֶת־הֶחָז֑וֹן וָאֲבַקְשָׁ֣ה בִינָ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֛ה עֹמֵ֥ד לְנֶגְדִּ֖י כְּמַרְאֵה־גָֽבֶר׃

controles.web: When I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, I sought to understand it; and behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.
controles.kjv: And it came to pass, when I, even I Daniel, had seen the vision, and sought for the meaning, then, behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.
controles.livre: E aconteceu que, tendo eu, Daniel visto a visão, e buscando entendê-la, eis que alguém semelhante a um homem se pôs diante de mim.

versos.hebraico: וָאֶשְׁמַ֥ע קוֹל־אָדָ֖ם בֵּ֣ין אוּלָ֑י וַיִּקְרָא֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר גַּבְרִיאֵ֕ל הָבֵ֥ן לְהַלָּ֖ז אֶת־הַמַּרְאֶֽה׃

controles.web: I heard a man’s voice between the banks of the Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this man to understand the vision.
controles.kjv: And I heard a man’s voice between the banks of Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this man to understand the vision.
controles.livre: E ouvi uma voz de homem entre as margens de Ulai, que gritou e disse: Gabriel, explica a visão a este.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּבֹא֙ אֵ֣צֶל עָמְדִ֔י וּבְבֹא֣וֹ נִבְעַ֔תִּי וָאֶפְּלָ֖ה עַל־פָּנָ֑י וַיֹּ֤אמֶר אֵלַי֙ הָבֵ֣ן בֶּן־אָדָ֔ם כִּ֖י לְעֶת־קֵ֥ץ הֶחָזֽוֹן׃

controles.web: So he came near where I stood; and when he came, I was frightened, and fell on my face: but he said to me, Understand, son of man; for the vision belongs to the time of the end.
controles.kjv: So he came near where I stood: and when he came, I was afraid, and fell upon my face: but he said unto me, Understand, O son of man: for at the time of the end shall be the vision.
controles.livre: Então ele veio para perto de onde eu estava; e quando ele veio, me assombrei, e caí sobre meu rosto. Porém ele me disse: Entende, filho do homem; porque esta visão será para o tempo do fim.

versos.hebraico: וּבְדַבְּר֣וֹ עִמִּ֔י נִרְדַּ֥מְתִּי עַל־פָּנַ֖י אָ֑רְצָה וַיִּ֨גַּע־בִּ֔י וַיַּֽעֲמִידֵ֖נִי עַל־עָמְדִֽי׃

controles.web: Now as he was speaking with me, I fell into a deep sleep with my face toward the ground; but he touched me, and set me upright.
controles.kjv: Now as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright.
controles.livre: E enquanto ele estava falando comigo, adormeci sobre meu rosto em terra; então ele me tocou, e fez ficar de pé.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר֙ הִנְנִ֣י מוֹדִֽיעֲךָ֔ אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶ֖ה בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַזָּ֑עַם כִּ֖י לְמוֹעֵ֥ד קֵֽץ׃

controles.web: He said, Behold, I will make you know what shall be in the latter time of the indignation; for it belongs to the appointed time of the end.
controles.kjv: And he said, Behold, I will make thee know what shall be in the last end of the indignation: for at the time appointed the end shall be.
controles.livre: E disse: Eis que eu te farei saber o que irá acontecer no fim da ira; pois será no tempo certo, o fim.

versos.hebraico: הָאַ֥יִל אֲשֶׁר־רָאִ֖יתָ בַּ֣עַל הַקְּרָנָ֑יִם מַלְכֵ֖י מָדַ֥י וּפָרָֽס׃

controles.web: The ram which you saw, that had the two horns, they are the kings of Media and Persia.
controles.kjv: The ram which thou sawest having two horns are the kings of Media and Persia.
controles.livre: Aquele carneiro que viste com dois chifres, são os reis da Média e da Pérsia.

versos.hebraico: וְהַצָּפִ֥יר הַשָּׂעִ֖יר מֶ֣לֶךְ יָוָ֑ן וְהַקֶּ֤רֶן הַגְּדוֹלָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בֵּין־עֵינָ֔יו ה֖וּא הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃

controles.web: The rough male goat is the king of Greece: and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.
controles.kjv: And the rough goat is the king of Grecia: and the great horn that is between his eyes is the first king.
controles.livre: Porém o bode peludo é o rei da Grécia; e o chifre grande que tinha entre seus olhos é o primeiro rei.

versos.hebraico: וְהַ֨נִּשְׁבֶּ֔רֶת וַתַּֽעֲמֹ֥דְנָה אַרְבַּ֖ע תַּחְתֶּ֑יהָ אַרְבַּ֧ע מַלְכֻי֛וֹת מִגּ֥וֹי יַעֲמֹ֖דְנָה וְלֹ֥א בְכֹחֽוֹ׃

controles.web: As for that which was broken, in the place where four stood up, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not with his power.
controles.kjv: Now that being broken, whereas four stood up for it, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not in his power.
controles.livre: E quanto a ter sido quebrado, e terem surgido quatro em seu lugar, significa que quatro reinos surgirão daquela nação, mas não com a força dele.

versos.hebraico: וּֽבְאַחֲרִית֙ מַלְכוּתָ֔ם כְּהָתֵ֖ם הַפֹּשְׁעִ֑ים יַעֲמֹ֛ד מֶ֥לֶךְ עַז־פָּנִ֖ים וּמֵבִ֥ין חִידֽוֹת׃

controles.web: In the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors have come to the full, a king of fierce face, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.
controles.kjv: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up.
controles.livre: E ao fim do império deles, quando os transgressores se acabarem, se levantará um rei de rosto feroz, e entendido em astúcias.

versos.hebraico: וְעָצַ֤ם כֹּחוֹ֙ וְלֹ֣א בְכֹח֔וֹ וְנִפְלָא֥וֹת יַשְׁחִ֖ית וְהִצְלִ֣יחַ וְעָשָׂ֑ה וְהִשְׁחִ֥ית עֲצוּמִ֖ים וְעַם־קְדֹשִֽׁים׃

controles.web: His power shall be mighty, but not by his own power; and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper in what he does; and he shall destroy the mighty ones and the holy people.
controles.kjv: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people.
controles.livre: E sua força ganhará vigor, mas não com sua própria força; e destruirá terrivelmente, e terá sucesso naquilo que fizer; e destruirá os fortes e o povo dos santos.

versos.hebraico: וְעַל־שִׂכְל֗וֹ וְהִצְלִ֤יחַ מִרְמָה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ וּבִלְבָב֣וֹ יַגְדִּ֔יל וּבְשַׁלְוָ֖ה יַשְׁחִ֣ית רַבִּ֑ים וְעַ֤ל־שַׂר־שָׂרִים֙ יַעֲמֹ֔ד וּבְאֶ֥פֶס יָ֖ד יִשָּׁבֵֽר׃

controles.web: Through his policy he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and he shall destroy many in their security. He shall also stand up against the prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.
controles.kjv: And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify himself in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand.
controles.livre: E com sua inteligência fará prosperar o engano em seu poder;  e em seu coração se engrandecerá, e com tranquilidade destruirá a muitos; e se levantará contra o Príncipe dos príncipes, porém sem mão será quebrantado.

versos.hebraico: וּמַרְאֵ֨ה הָעֶ֧רֶב וְהַבֹּ֛קֶר אֲשֶׁ֥ר נֶאֱמַ֖ר אֱמֶ֣ת ה֑וּא וְאַתָּה֙ סְתֹ֣ם הֶֽחָז֔וֹן כִּ֖י לְיָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃

controles.web: The vision of the evenings and mornings which has been told is true: but seal up the vision; for it belongs to many days to come.
controles.kjv: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told is true: wherefore shut thou up the vision; for it shall be for many days.
controles.livre: E a visão da tarde e a manhã que foi dita é verdadeira; tu, porém guarda em segredo  a visão, porque é para muitos dias.

versos.hebraico: וַאֲנִ֣י דָנִיֵּ֗אל נִהְיֵ֤יתִי וְנֶֽחֱלֵ֨יתִי֙ יָמִ֔ים וָאָק֕וּם וָאֶֽעֱשֶׂ֖ה אֶת־מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וָאֶשְׁתּוֹמֵ֥ם עַל־הַמַּרְאֶ֖ה וְאֵ֥ין מֵבִֽין׃פ

controles.web: I, Daniel, fainted, and was sick certain days; then I rose up, and did the king’s business: and I wondered at the vision, but no one understood it.
controles.kjv: And I Daniel fainted, and was sick certain days; afterward I rose up, and did the king’s business; and I was astonished at the vision, but none understood it.
controles.livre: E eu, Daniel, enfraqueci, e fiquei doente por alguns dias; depois me levantei, e tratei dos negócios do do rei; porém continuei espantado acerca da visão, e não havia quem a entendesse.
